title: Q-STD-jsonld: Emit JSON-LD on every content page
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/open-standards.json::"id": "site-jsonld".*"status": "adopted"
**Status:** open

OPEN-STANDARDS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): emit Schema.org JSON-LD (Article, Dataset, SoftwareApplication) on every site content page and check it in foundation findable.

size: M
Out of scope: new formats not in doctrine/open-standards.json.

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation openstd --check passes and the registry row for site-jsonld reads adopted with evidence files that exist.
